quarterly_data.signal: Second correction (filed 09-23-2026) to the Korea District Heating Corporation power-plant EPC contract (2024-08-21 to 2028-12-01): BHI's share rises again to KRW 248,983,409,818 from KRW 243,946,121,818 (67.8% of 2023 revenue); the total is now USD 55,045,000 plus KRW 237,909,322,273 excluding VAT. Same contract as the 08-07-2026 correction, not a new order.
